references.text: Joshua suddenly came upon the enemy after a night march, a similar surprise attack as at Gibeon
The background to this attack where the kings of the north gathered at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel
The Lord's promise of victory to Joshua that gave him courage to launch a sudden attack
Sisera was surprised at the Kishon River, a similar surprise attack with God's help
Gideon's surprise attack against the Midianites where the enemy fell into confusion
Saul suddenly came upon the Ammonites at the morning watch, a similar tactic of surprise attack
The Israelites fell upon the Philistines who were in confusion, using the same expression for attacking the enemy
The Lord rises up as at Mount Perazim to carry out His work suddenly
